test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 02 March 2023)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘PAINT’ is written as ‘80’ and ‘DROP’ is written as ‘59’. How will ‘MARKET’ be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : Sum of the position values of opposite letters according to the English alphabetical series and number of letters within the word are added. ​So, • ‘PAINT’ is written as ‘80’
